summary: Crypto and equities show a cautious, risk-off tone: Bitcoin and most major altcoins are under pressure, while Bitcoin dominance has risen toward 60% as traders favor relative safety.[3][6] Geopolitical and inflation concerns are weighing on risk assets; Brent crude has surged above $116 while gold and major technology stocks have declined.[2][7]

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reason: The titles frame Bitcoin as vulnerable to lower highs and a downside continuation after rejection from the $84K area, with the $79K-$80K retest treated as a critical support test.

signals.name: Altcoins
signals.reason: The October 15 title states that altcoin selling should stop and identifies an upcoming buying window, implying a bullish reversal view after capitulation.

signals.name: Ethereum
signals.reason: Ethereum is weakening more sharply than Bitcoin amid broad altcoin selling and elevated liquidations.[3][6]

signals.name: Solana
signals.reason: Solana is among the major altcoins declining faster than Bitcoin during the current risk-off move.[3][6]
